---
title: Generate distribution plots
output: html_document
params:
  df_rdv:
    label: "Dataframe"
    value: NA
  col:
    label: "Column to plot"
    value: "length"
  stratify_by:
    label: "Grouping column"
    value: NULL
  filter_col:
    label: "Column to filter values on"
    value: NA
  filter_val:
    label: "Value to select"
    value: NA
  calc_length:
    label: "Calculate length?"
    value: FALSE
  calc_diff:
    label: "Calculate difference between start and end datetime?"
    value: FALSE
  side_by_side:
    label: "Plot side by side?"
    value: TRUE
  filter_condition:
    label: "Filter RDV"
    value: NULL
  description:
    label: "Label used in report"
    value: NA
  transform:
    label: "Transformation of data"
    value: "No transformation"
  density_bw:
    label: "Adjust smoothing bandwidth in density plot"
    value: 1
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# If a filter column and value is provided, filter the input RDV before passing

my_data <- list()

if (!is.null(params$df_rdv)) {
  if ((params$filter_col == 'NA') || (params$filter_val == 'NA')) {
    df <- params$df_rdv
  } else {
    for (i in params$filter_val) {
      my_data[[i]] <- params$df_rdv %>%
        dplyr::filter(!!as.name(params$filter_col) == !!i)
    }
  }

  # If no description
  if (params$description == 'NA') {
    description <- params$filter_val
  } else {
    description <- params$description
  }
}

```

`r if(!is.null(params$df_rdv)){paste0("# Value Distributions for ", description)}`


```{r results, fig.dim = c(8, 8), out.width="100%", comment=NA, results='asis'}

if (!is.null(params$df_rdv)) {
  if (length(my_data) > 0) {
    count = 1
    for (i in my_data) {
      cat(paste0("\n\n## ", description[count], "\n"))
      gdp <- driveanalytics::gen_distribution_plots(
        i,
        params$col,
        params$stratify_by,
        side_by_side = FALSE,
        params$calc_length,
        params$calc_diff,
        params$filter_condition,
        xlab = params$description
      )
      grid::grid.newpage()
      grid::grid.draw(gdp$plot)
      cat(gdp$test_result)
      knitr::kable(gdp$tbl_n, format = "latex", row.names = FALSE)
      count = count + 1
    }
  } else {
    gdp <- driveanalytics::gen_distribution_plots(
      df,
      params$col,
      params$stratify_by,
      side_by_side = FALSE,
      params$calc_length,
      params$calc_diff,
      params$filter_condition,
      xlab = description
    )
    grid::grid.draw(gdp$plot)
    cat(gdp$test_result)
    knitr::kable(gdp$tbl_n, format = "latex", row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

```
